integrity: Analytic derivation with direct exact-rational checks of 281 identities on independently generated finite instances; tests support but do not replace proof. No independent review, audit, priority determination, or certification.
scientific_limitations: Real unweighted Hamming graphs with d≥2 and q≥3 only. All-exponent optimality relies on the published equivariance/uniqueness theorem; exact norms are asserted only at endpoint exponents and p=2. The binary specialization is prior art. Bibliographic coverage is nonexhaustive.
title: Exact minimal cut and cycle projections for nonbinary Hamming graphs
